title: narcissus bulbocodium var. graellsii
intro: Narcissus bulbocodium var. graellsii, commonly known as the Hoop Petticoat Daffodil, is a variety of flowering plant that belongs to the Amaryllidaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used to treat various health conditions, including anxiety, insomnia, and pain relief, due to its therapeutic actions such as sedative and analgesic properties. The health benefits of Narcissus bulbocodium var. graellsii include reducing inflammation and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal effects.
